alternatives.name: MODULE_FIRST_NAVIGATION
tradeoffs: Encourages siloed dashboards; scales poorly as capabilities grow.

alternatives.name: INSPECTOR_ONLY_EXPLAINABILITY
tradeoffs: Too deep for attention-layer scanning workflows.

alternatives.name: FIVE_DOMAIN_NAV_WITH_GLOBAL_CONTEXT_AND_DUAL_EXPLAINABILITY
tradeoffs: Requires discipline from feature teams; context bar consumes vertical space; two explainability patterns to implement.

negative: Five-domain nav requires discipline; feature teams may resist nesting.
Context bar consumes vertical space on every route.
Inspector plus drawer equals two explainability patterns to implement.
RESEARCH and PORTFOLIO gating may confuse users until authorized.
positive: Consistent mental model as capabilities grow.
Explainability path defined before backend APIs.
Aligns with Revision 3, Swim With the Whales, and ADR-WHALE-001.
Prototype V0.5 validates core flows A through K plus EXPLORE entry.

decision.summary: Adopt five-domain information architecture (NOW, EXPLORE, WORKSPACE, RESEARCH, PORTFOLIO), mandatory global context bar (mode, AS OF, scope, quality), dual explainability (drawer L1-2, inspector L3-6), epistemic classification on nontrivial values, capability honesty, attention reason codes without opaque rank score, and Institutional Flow naming.
decision.title: Navigation, context, and explainability model

effectivity.non_authorization_statement: Acceptance records the UX architecture decision only. It does not authorize production frontend implementation, chart framework selection, live data connections, broker controls, or modification of governed evidence or canonical contracts.
